node.statement: Using W.c0_cb=c0, d_U<=c0*epsilon_U and d_V<=c0*epsilon_V yield d_U,d_V<=c0*W.L*epsilon<=t_3 because W.K3>=W.c0_cb*W.L. The two reset-unit norms obey the identical bound, and the displayed global unit error is <=c0*epsilon<=t_3. Finally 0<=c0*epsilon<=t_3, so lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone upgrades the given extended c0*epsilon-inclusion w to an extended t_3-inclusion; by def-extended-delta-inclusion this is a non-unital extended inclusion (no exact-unitality condition is part of that definition).
